posts.author: nobodyyouknow
posts.title: Think Tank- Absence of Admins
posts.html:
A think tank is the popular name for research foundations, generally private, that gather experts to study policy questions and make recommendations. There are think tanks representing positions across the political spectrum, and they are sometimes funded according to the viewpoints they represent.

I thought we could use this idea here to come up with ways to get around the absence of the admins during the nighttime hours of England when most admins sleep. (They have lives so its perfectly understandable to me.) Pour your ideas out here. This way out of like 10 dumb ideas we get one good one that may solve the problem. Maybe we can find a less practical than having an admin on, but figure out some sort of ingame system.

Admins if you think this idea is stupid lock the thread by all means.

posts.author: Hawkmoon
posts.title: Re: Think Tank- Absence of Admins
posts.html:
Why not have the admins work in shifts? Instead of having several thousand of them playing at any given time in the afternoon, and then when the evening comes around there are suddenly none of them, have them work in shifts.

For example: (times are GMT)

MONDAY:
00:00 - 02:00 - Some dude in the USA
02:00 - 04:00 - Some dude in Canada
04:00 - 06:00 - Some guy in the USA

And that goes on and on until the Americans hit the hay, and the Brits/Europeans come out to say hi and do the admin duties; there can be a similar timetable for every day.

It will require an increase in the number of admins who can make a commitment to work at certain hours, but we know that life comes before gaming and hence we can accept that there will still be gaps in the timetable where certain things come up that mean admins can't play, but there will be less of them, and they will be shorter, with this more organised method.

Of course, admins who aren't on duty can still play in the server if they want to.

And it doesn't even have to be admins, I think moderators have similar powers.
